##### Project general facts

The Greens at Sobha Sanctuary emerges as a truly exceptional villa community crafted for residents seeking balance, privacy, and restorative living within one of the most visionary master-planned destinations. This remarkable collection offers four-bedroom Garden Villas and five-bedroom Courtyard Villas, thoughtfully designed with smart-home readiness and generous outdoor spaces that invite residents to embrace a lifestyle of calm and connection. Every residence has been shaped around the philosophy of serene, nature-immersed living, creating homes that feel both intimate and expansive, where privacy and everyday convenience exist in perfect harmony.

The amenities at The Greens are nothing short of extraordinary, offering a complete environment shaped through distinct layers of nature, water, wellness, and community. Residents enjoy a magnificent beach lagoon with a lazy river, a wellness centre and spa facilities with hydrotherapy, saunas, and steam rooms, alongside a forest adventure playground, sports courts, and outdoor fitness zones. The community also features meditation lawns, Zen rock gardens, forest trails, hammock courts, reflexology paths, and a dedicated pet therapy garden, ensuring that every dimension of wellbeing is thoughtfully catered for within a setting of profound natural beauty.

The interiors of The Greens are a celebration of refined contemporary elegance, where every detail has been meticulously crafted to create an atmosphere of warmth and sophistication. Each villa features spacious layouts flooded with natural light, expansive living and dining areas designed for effortless entertaining, and a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor spaces that embraces the surrounding greenery. The master bedrooms offer serene retreats with beautiful views, while the kitchens and bathrooms reflect the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship, delivering a living experience that is both luxurious and deeply comforting.

##### Location description and benefits

Sobha Sanctuary stands as a remarkable masterplan designed to hold life at scale without losing its sense of quiet, bringing together approximately twenty thousand families while being shaped around nature, balance, and daily ease. This visionary destination is defined by its extraordinary commitment to green living, with approximately half of the community devoted to open and green spaces anchored by a magnificent park, alongside a sprawling network of forest walks, shaded trails, botanical gardens, and sensory landscapes. The result is a truly immersive environment where nature is woven through every zone, creating moments of stillness, perspective, and connection with the environment.

The community is defined by its exceptional commitment to wellness and active living, supported by an extensive leisure loop that invites recreation, exploration, and everyday movement, alongside a purpose-built wellness loop designed for walking, cycling, and health-focused activities. Residents benefit from an impressive array of outdoor fitness zones, sports courts, and a full-size football field, tennis court, and cricket ground, along with inclusive wellness areas designed for seniors. Sustainability is woven throughout the masterplan, from smart mobility and connected cycling networks to integrated systems that minimise environmental impact, creating a community that is as responsible as it is beautiful.

The surroundings offer a wealth of experiences that cater to every member of the family, from vibrant social gatherings at community hubs and shared courtyards to children's play spaces, youth-friendly areas, and walkable retail destinations. The community mall, farmers' market experiences, co-working spaces, and multi-purpose halls support the rhythm of everyday connection, while amphitheatre settings create moments worth sharing. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the tranquillity of a nature-immersed sanctuary with the vibrant energy of a truly connected and thriving community.
